metadata.name: BHISHMA Local CVE Intelligence Database
metadata.note: Detection only. CVEs are shown only when exact affected versions match.

cves.title: Apache HTTP Server Path Traversal and File Disclosure
cves.description: Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 may allow path traversal and file disclosure when misconfigured.
cves.remediation: Upgrade Apache HTTP Server to 2.4.51 or later and review access control configuration.

cves.title: Apache HTTP Server Path Traversal and Possible Remote Code Execution
cves.description: Apache HTTP Server 2.4.50 may allow path traversal and possible remote code execution under specific configurations.
cves.remediation: Upgrade Apache immediately to 2.4.51 or later.

cves.title: Backdoored vsftpd Version
cves.description: vsftpd 2.3.4 contains a known malicious backdoor.
cves.remediation: Remove this version and install a trusted patched package.

cves.title: Webmin Remote Command Execution
cves.description: Certain Webmin versions are affected by remote command execution through password change functionality.
cves.remediation: Upgrade Webmin to a patched version and restrict administrative access.
